## What's Changed
* ci: our own dependency updates merge themselves, through ship by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/101
* chore(ci): bump the ship group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/102
* fix(audit): audits see the user's later messages (FR-116) by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/106
* chore(deps): bump the deps group across 1 directory with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/105
* chore(ci): bump actions/setup-node from 4 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/103
* chore(ci): bump actions/checkout from 4 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/104

## New Contributors
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/102

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/compare/v2.16.1...v2.16.2

## What's Changed
* docs: renumber the session-progress requirement to FR-115 by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/99
* Release 2.16.1: CHANGELOG and install commands by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/100


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/compare/v2.16.0...v2.16.1

## What's Changed
* ci: release through ship v0.5.0 by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/90
* fix(audit): goal-based findings must quote a rule that exists (FR-113) by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/93
* fix: audits see output excerpts and the step's own results (FR-114, #91) by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/92
* Release in one dispatch: version from the tag (ship v0.6.0) by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/96
* Release 2.16.0: CHANGELOG and install commands by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/98


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/compare/v2.15.0...v2.16.0

## What's Changed
* fix: audits see the session's completed tool calls (FR-111, #87) by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/88


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/compare/v2.14.2...v2.15.0

## What's Changed
* fix(audit): skip critique steering in subagent sessions by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/86
* ci: release through jflowers/ship's shared npm workflow by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/pull/85


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-supervisor/compare/v2.14.1...v2.14.2

issues.title: Docs: 2.5.0 — server-log routing and configurable auditor model
Audit flags an in-experiment edit as 'edited before debug_open', ignoring earlier steps in the trace
Auditor blames the agent for tool arguments another plugin injected
Protected-state check blocks any glob pattern with a ** segment
